action: Remediate 3 critical CIS Level 1 failures: disable Telnet, enforce SSH key-only auth, enable auditd
rationale: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS failed 3 critical and 7 high CIS Benchmark Level 1 controls.
key_findings: Telnet active on port 23 (CIS 2.1.1) — MITRE T1040
auditd service not running (CIS 4.1.1) — MITRE T1562.002
SUID binary /usr/bin/nmap outside baseline — MITRE T1548.001
SELinux in permissive mode — MITRE T1068

evidence_references.remediation: Set PermitRootLogin no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config; systemctl restart sshd
systemctl disable --now telnet.socket; apt purge telnetd
